_doc: Type voices. All fonts are free on Google Fonts. scale is the type ratio. base is body px. tracking is letter-spacing em for display, label. weights: display, body, label. case is the label case.

friendly-humanist.describe: Rounded humanist sans. Warm and easy to read at any size.

geometric-modern.describe: A clean geometric sans with a confident, current feel.

neutral-grotesk.describe: A neutral grotesque. It stays out of the way, so the content leads.

editorial-warm.describe: A soft, characterful serif for headlines with a plain sans for reading.

classic-serif.describe: A readable text serif that feels trained and trustworthy.

luxe-didone.describe: High-contrast display serif, light sans body and wide-tracked small caps.

calm-serif.describe: A light, quiet serif over a soft sans, with generous line height.

tech-grotesk.describe: Quirky grotesque headings, a workmanlike body and mono for data.

playful-rounded.describe: Bouncy rounded headings. Fun, but the body text stays calm.

bold-condensed.describe: Tall condensed headings with a sturdy body. Built for speed and scores.

brutal-mono.describe: Monospace headings and a blunt grotesque body. Raw and honest.

soft-display.describe: An expressive display grotesque with a quiet geometric body.

elegant-light.describe: A delicate display serif, a calm sans and airy small caps.

humane-sans.describe: One friendly, open sans for everything. Plain and kind.

data-dense.describe: A compact engineering sans with matching mono. Tables stay readable at small sizes.
